messages:
Maya: Quick sync on the trace drilldown UX — need final call on download CTA copy/placement and a11y checklist.
Liam: Keep copy short. We already use 'Download snapshot' elsewhere, so 'Download trace' for consistency.
Alex: Backend produces a ZIP and triggers a browser download. 'Download' matches behavior.
Sam: Accessibility: prefer 'Download trace'. Use a role=status aria-live element to announce 'Preparing download...' and 'Download started'.
Jordan: Keyboard: if immediate download, keep focus on the button while spinner shows. If opening options modal, trap focus.
Maya: Proposed layout: primary 'Download trace' top-right, kebab left for 'Export options'. Keyboard order follows visual.
Liam: Add small tooltip: 'Includes spans, logs, attachments — ZIP ~2MB'. Ensure CTA color contrast >=4.5:1.
Alex: Implementation notes: button id="trace-download", aria-label="Download trace"; separate div#trace-download-status role=status aria-live="polite". Ensure 44px min target and visible focus ring.
Sam: Also add a copy-to-clipboard microbutton for correlation IDs with aria-label='Copy correlation ID'. Truncate visually but include full ID in offscreen text for screen readers.
Jordan: I'll file two tickets: live-region/focus handling (@alex) and copy-ID pattern + tests (@sam @alex).
Maya: Action items: Maya updates Figma + final copy; Alex implements + tests (ETA Fri); Sam runs a11y pass (ETA Mon); Jordan creates tickets & QA checklist. I'll link tickets here when done. :thumbsup:
